Thursday shifts everything: the Moon enters your 10th House and trines Jupiter in your 9th House, unlocking career breakthroughs. Venus enters your 7th House, igniting deep romance through the weekend. Stay bold in your career sector — opportunities arrive fast. Have one brave conversation in your 7th House before Friday that could change everything. Follow for daily updates.
